**q25** — Engine: CEL (google/cel-go) wrapped by the `Engine` type in `internal/filter/engine.go:13-27`, with the memo field schema in `internal/filter/schema.go:88,232+`. Mechanism: the CEL AST is parsed into a dialect-agnostic condition tree/IR (`internal/filter/ir.go`, `parser.go`) and each dialect driver calls `filter.AppendConditions(..., filter.DialectSQLite|DialectPostgres|DialectMySQL, &where, &args)` (`internal/filter/helpers.go:9`; `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57-61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:54-58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:65-69`), which renders dialect-specific SQL fragments + bind args via the switch on `DialectName` in `internal/filter/render.go:231,365,452,502,565`.

**q26** — `memo_relation` (both directions), `attachment` (rows + backing files), `memo` (the row itself, plus all comment memo rows, which recurse through the same cleanup) — `store/memo.go:140-158`, `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:568-582`. `memo_share` rows are removed by the schema-level `ON DELETE CASCADE` on `memo_share.memo_id` (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:109`), not by explicit code. `reaction` rows are not deleted.

**q27** — Mechanism: the built `web/dist` output is compiled into the Go binary with `//go:embed dist/*` and served by Echo's static middleware plus an SPA fallback. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-21` (embed), `:40-59` (`Serve`, static middleware + `spaFallbackMiddleware`); registered from the server setup (`server/server.go`, frontend service construction `NewFrontendService`, `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:34`).

**q28**
```
s3presign runner — server/runner/s3presign/runner.go: RunOnce at startup, then a 12h time.Ticker (runner.go:27-41); started at server/server.go:161-171
webhook async dispatch workers — internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-56: 4 goroutines draining a buffered channel (queue-driven, not scheduled)
SSE hub — server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go: per-connection goroutines, event-driven
```
Unused infra note: `internal/scheduler` (a cron-expression job scheduler, `internal/scheduler/doc.go`, `scheduler.go`, `parser.go`) is **not** used by the server — it is only referenced from its own tests (`internal/scheduler/integration_test.go:13`, `example_test.go:10`). Also, `server/runner/memopayload` is not started as a background runner; only its `RebuildMemoPayload` helper is called inline from memo handlers (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`), leaving `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`) uncalled by the server.

**q29** — Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:156` (attached to the transport at `web/src/connect.ts:188`), with token state in `web/src/auth-state.ts`. Tokens managed: short-lived access token (sent as `Authorization: Bearer`, refreshed proactively when near expiry and reactively on `Unauthenticated`, `web/src/connect.ts:116-172`) and an HttpOnly refresh-token cookie used by `AuthService.RefreshToken` via a separate interceptor-free transport (`web/src/connect.ts:65-79`); Personal Access Tokens are also accepted as Bearer tokens by the backend. Backend validation package: `server/auth` (`server/auth/authenticator.go`, `server/auth/token.go`), invoked from the gateway/Connect auth middleware in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:69` and `server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go`.
